title: Fix rejected drain PR #131 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-43)
description:
Drain PR #131 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-43`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-43 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-43`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-43` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- Unrelated change to heartbeat.mjs timeout value not mentioned in task scope
- Heartbeat timeout reduction from 30000ms to 10000ms introduces potential race condition without justification
